visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a brown coat and a thick gray scarf, stands in front of the MEGA Don Quijote store entrance in Shibuya. She smiles brightly and gestures towards the camera. The background shows the iconic blue penguin mascot and bright yellow and red signage. (2) The scene cuts to various product displays inside the store. A shelf filled with SHIMBI METHOD skincare products is shown. The woman is seen in a split-screen or close-up applying a white sheet mask to her face, smoothing it over her cheeks with her fingers. (3) The camera focuses on a pressurized can of facial wash. The woman dispenses a large ball of thick, gray-tinged foam onto her palm. She squeezes the foam to demonstrate its dense, elastic texture before applying it to her cheeks in a bathroom setting. (4) Close-ups of red and white toothpaste packaging from the brand HAMIGAKIDO. The woman points to her teeth while smiling broadly, showcasing the results. (5) Various tubs of hair wax are shown on a shelf. The woman picks up a light blue tub of LIPPS Wet Blast. A macro shot shows a finger dipping into the smooth, white cream-like wax. (6) The camera moves to a blue tube of Acnes labo acne cream hanging on a display hook. Both the front and the detailed Japanese instructions on the back of the packaging are shown. (7) An IHADA sunscreen powder compact is displayed in its packaging. The camera captures the product labels and the compact's design. (8) A wide shot of a dense display of Sanrio character merchandise. The woman holds up a small gray plush keychain of a character. She then displays a variety of Sanrio-themed items including hair clips, curlers, and pink pajamas with character patterns. (9) White Hanes Beefy-T t-shirts are shown in their plastic packaging on hangers. The woman holds one to show the cotton texture and the logo on the neck. (10) Large bags of soy protein powder in sweet potato and matcha flavors are shown on shelves. The camera zooms in on the ingredient labels. (11) A 4-pack of blue elleair lotion tissues is highlighted on a shelf. The woman returns to the frame at the end, concluding her presentation in the same outdoor location.
